buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b 3.38.7 "$HOME/flutter" && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" config --no-cli-animations && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" pub get && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" build web --release --dart-define=AUTO_EMAIL=$AUTO_EMAIL --dart-define=AUTO_PASSWORD=$AUTO_PASSWORD
